Package mesos.am30.gameModel.event

package mesos.am30.gameModel.event
Package for Events definition.
This Package contains the definition of all Events for the Game, including both the Building and the Card ones.
The Event handling logic has been implemented following the Strategy Pattern, in order to generalize all the Events regarding of their type.
